Regenerate with tools/update_vuln_data.py; do not edit by hand. 'uri' and 'filename' are retire.js extractors: patterns matched against a script's address, with §§version§§ standing for the version. A vulnerability applies to versions from 'atOrAbove' (when present) up to, not including, 'below'.
